usedFor: Calendly provides the meeting event, and the Summarize Text app turns its text into a short summary through “Summarize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting recap is created” in Calendly, then “Summarize Text” in Summarize Text
bestTemplate.why: A recap is long text by nature, and the action condenses it into a concise summary.

watchOut: “When a meeting recap is created” requires a paid Calendly plan, so confirm your plan before you build on it.
